ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across the majority of the visible surface (approx. 90%) with a high-contrast low-intensity (black) border along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric area occupying the central surface of both lobes. A continuous black perimeter band follows the trailing edge and tips. Two discrete dark circular pixel clusters are located centrally, approximately 50 pixels below the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated 90-degree aperture and moderate depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge boundary. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying from small-scale irregularities to large convex scallops, particularly on the right lobe distal region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast dark pixel clusters with irregular, raised textures (barnacle colonization) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and associated dark scarring visible on the distal tips and leading edges of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pair of small, dark focal pigmentation spots situated vertically near the center of the white ventral expanse below the median notch.
